caption: The drawing depicts three human figures crucified on wooden crosses; the central figure, identified with a sign labeled "INRI," has a crown, visible wounds, and is covered in blood. The two flanking figures are also nailed to crosses. Below the central cross, four figures stand or kneel, two of them with halos. One wears a blue and white headdress, and another is draped in a red and blue garment. On the left side, a figure in a red cap and multicolored clothing stands beside a brown horse with a black mane. The background consists of brown mountains beneath a cloudy sky. In the upper left corner is a large red disk with a face, resembling the sun, and in the top right corner is a crescent moon with a human-like face. The overall color palette includes reds, browns, greens, blues, and tans, with thick, dark outlines and simplified forms.
title: Station of the Cross No. 12: "Jesus Dies Upon the Cross"
